useCases.title: Analyse what's performing on a LinkedIn profile
useCases.message: Help me understand what's working on a LinkedIn profile. Ask me whose profile to analyse: mine or a competitor's. Then go through their recent posts, pull engagement data, and give me a breakdown of what topics, formats, and hooks are performing best.
